faqs.answer: Common warning signs include gas odors, hissing sounds near pipes, damaged gas lines and problems with gas appliances.

faqs.question: What should I do if I smell gas?
faqs.answer: Leave the area, avoid creating sparks or flames and contact appropriate emergency support or qualified professionals.
